## Legal, Approvals & Clear Title Verification
- **Planning Authority**: Pune Metropolitan Region Development Authority (PMRDA).
- **RERA Compliance**: Fully registered under MahaRERA with separate RERA certificate numbers for each individual phase.
- **Land Title**: 100% Freehold clear title land with distinct 7/12 extract demarcation for NA plots.
- **Bank Financing**: Pre-approved by major nationalized and private banks (SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis Bank, Bank of Baroda).

## Micro-Market Growth Drivers & Infrastructure Catalyst
1. **PMRDA Ring Road Interchange**: The upcoming 128-km 8-lane Ring Road has a dedicated interchange at Bhugaon, cutting commute times to Hinjewadi Phase 3 to just 15 minutes.
2. **Chandani Chowk Modernization**: Multi-tier flyover system now fully operational, eliminating bottlenecks between Kothrud, Mumbai-Bangalore Highway, and Paud Road.
3. **Pune Metro Line 3 Extension**: Proposed spur line along Paud Road connecting Bhugaon to Kothrud and Shivaji Nagar.
